A TRANSPORT's capacity ability now prints inline. All the previous findings are fixed. One gap left of the same kind, not reached in this list: the Every round abilities filter `!/first battle round/i.test(ab.text)` drops any ability that names the first battle round anywhere. Tested: 'At the start of each battle round (excluding the first battle round), this unit heals 1 wound' appears in neither First round nor Every round. That leaves out an every-round case the function says it covers. The rules side has no such exclusion. Display only, not a rule issue: the Transports line turns '\n- ' into '; ', which gives '….; It cannot…', and an italic '*…*' line keeps its asterisks, because inline() does not process single '*'.
fix: In `round`, exclude only what First round already shows: `group(allAbs.filter(([u, ab]) => /start of (the|each|every) battle round/i.test(ab.text) && !/start of the first battle round/i.test(ab.text)))`. Optionally, in Transports, strip a trailing '.' before joining with '; ' and drop the '*' markers of italic lines.
